name: Booxos Shop Connect
author: booxos

sections.description:
Booxos Shop Connect is a powerful plugin designed to seamlessly integrate Booxos marketplace products into your WordPress website. This plugin allows vendors to display their Booxos marketplace products directly on their own website, enhancing visibility and driving traffic to their Booxos shop. Vendors can categorize products for better organization and user experience. Additionally, the plugin supports scheduling product fetch intervals, ensuring that the product listings are always up-to-date. When users click on a product, they are redirected to the Booxos website for purchase. The plugin also offers compatibility with Elementor, enabling vendors to create stunning product layouts effortlessly.

Key Features

  • Fetch Booxos Products: Automatically fetch products from the Booxos marketplace and display them on your WordPress website.

  • Category-wise Display: Organize and display products based on categories for better user navigation.

  • Real-Time Product Sync: Automatically sync products in real-time whenever they are updated on the Booxos marketplace, ensuring your website always displays the latest information.

  • Redirect to Booxos: Redirect users to the Booxos website when they click on a product, facilitating seamless purchases.

  • Elementor Compatibility: Use Elementor to design and customize product layouts, creating visually appealing product displays on your website.

Credits & 3rd Party Services

Booxos.com: Booxos Shop Connect uses Booxos to fetch products from the Booxos marketplace. The API requests include product details, categories, and other relevant information to display on your WordPress website. Service Terms, Privacy Policy.

Elementor: Booxos Shop Connect leverages the powerful design capabilities of Elementor Plugin to allow vendors to customize product layouts. The plugin utilizes various Elementor functions and classes to provide a seamless and intuitive design experience. Terms & Policies

WooCommerce: This plugin is built on and integrates with WooCommerce, the leading eCommerce platform for WordPress. Terms of Service, Privacy Policy

Developer Credits

This plugin was developed by ConicPlex, a leading agency specializing in WordPress plugin development. For more information about ConicPlex and their services, visit ConicPlex.
sections.installation:
1. Upload booxos-shop-connect to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. A new sub menu item Booxos Shop Connect will appear in your main Settings menu
sections.faq:
Is there a limit to the number of products I can display?

No, there is no limit to the number of products you can display from your Booxos marketplace on your WordPress website.

How often are the products updated?

You can set the fetch intervals in the plugin settings to automatically update the product listings at your preferred frequency.

Can I customize the product layout?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with Elementor, allowing you to design and customize the product layouts to match your website’s style.

Do users need to leave my site to purchase products?

Yes, when users click on a product, they are redirected to the Booxos website to complete the purchase.

Is the plugin compatible with the latest version of WordPress?

Yes, Booxos Shop Connect is tested up to WordPress version 6.7 and is regularly updated to ensure compatibility with the latest WordPress releases.
